title: Aether Compute Resource Requirement
description: Computational requirement declaration (SDP §6.1, ADR-0006). Workflows declare these; hardware names are FORBIDDEN here.

accelerator_class.description: I-6: vendor-neutral class. The runtime maps to vendor-specific execution at the backend.

license_slots.description: Map of named license slot to required count. The license-manager adapter resolves availability.

data_locality.description: CAS path prefixes that should be staged to node-local scratch.

allOf.description: I-6: hardware-specific fields are forbidden in resource requirements.

then.description: gpu_model is a hardware-specific field and violates I-6.
cpu_vendor is a hardware-specific field and violates I-6.
hostname is a hardware-specific field and violates I-6.
queue_name is a hardware-specific scheduler field and violates I-6.
